sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》庆祝成立175周年，致力于帮助您理解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Rachel Abrams, and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的雷切尔·艾布拉姆斯，这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: In its effort to deport as many undocumented immigrants as possible, the Trump administration
sentences.zh: 为了尽可能驱逐更多无证移民，特朗普政府

sentences.en: has relied more and more on a highly controversial strategy, deporting people to countries they have no connection to.
sentences.zh: 越来越依赖一项极具争议的策略，即把人们驱逐到他们没有任何联系的国家。

sentences.en: The practice has drawn outrage from civil rights groups and immigrant advocates.
sentences.zh: 这一做法引发了民权组织和移民维权人士的愤怒。

sentences.en: And last week, the federal court ruled that it was illegal because it violated people's rights to due process.
sentences.zh: 就在上周，联邦法院裁定此举违法，因为它侵犯了人们的正当程序权利。

sentences.en: The administration has challenged that ruling, and now it's in front of the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 政府对该裁决提出了上诉，现在案件已经到了最高法院。

sentences.en: And so today, my colleague Nicholas Casey explains what it actually looks like to be sent to a country you do not know.
sentences.zh: 所以今天，我的同事尼古拉斯·凯西将为我们解释，被送到一个你完全不了解的国家究竟是什么样的体验。

sentences.en: It's Monday, September 28th.
sentences.zh: 今天是9月28日，星期一。

sentences.en: Nick Casey, welcome back to The Daily.
sentences.zh: 尼克·凯西，欢迎回到《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Thanks, Rachel.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，雷切尔。

sentences.en: So, Nick, late last week, we got word that the Supreme Court was basically poised to decide whether to block the Trump administration's ability to deport people to countries they
sentences.zh: 那么，尼克，上周晚些时候我们得到消息，最高法院基本上准备决定是否阻止特朗普政府将人员驱逐到

sentences.en: are not from.
sentences.zh: 他们并非来自的国家的权力。

sentences.en: This is known as third country deportations.
sentences.zh: 这就是所谓的第三国驱逐。

sentences.en: It's also a practice that you've been following extensively.
sentences.zh: 这也是你一直在广泛追踪报道的一项做法。

sentences.en: So tell us how this works.
sentences.zh: 所以给我们讲讲这是怎么运作的吧。

sentences.en: So a third country deportation is when the US deports someone not to the country that they're from, but to just another country.
sentences.zh: 所谓的第三国驱逐，是指美国不是将某人驱逐回其原籍国，而是驱逐到另一个完全不同的国家。

sentences.en: It can even seem to be like a random country.
sentences.zh: 这甚至看起来像是一个随机选择的国家。

sentences.en: Often the person has no connection to the place that they're being sent to.
sentences.zh: 通常这个人与被送往的地方没有任何联系。

sentences.en: And this is a strategy which has become a hallmark now of the Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 而这一策略已经成为特朗普政府如今的一个标志。

sentences.en: Trump came to office, obviously promising to really ramp up deportations.
sentences.zh: 特朗普上任时，显然承诺要真正加大驱逐力度。

sentences.en: And this is very much part of it.
sentences.zh: 这很大程度上就是其中的一部分。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And so this week, the Supreme Court's going to decide, essentially, can this practice continue?
sentences.zh: 所以本周，最高法院将做出裁决，从根本上回答：这种做法还能继续吗？

sentences.en: And what do we know about the people who are being deported this way?
sentences.zh: 对于那些以这种方式被驱逐的人，我们了解多少？

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, according to the administration, this is a tool that it's been using to go after people with criminal records.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，根据政府的说法，这是一个用来对付有犯罪记录人员的工具。

sentences.en: They've even called them depraved monsters.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至称这些人是堕落的怪物。

sentences.en: They've said that they are the worst of the worSt.
sentences.zh: 他们说这些人是十恶不赦的坏蛋。

sentences.en: This is why it's doing it.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们这么做的原因。

sentences.en: And it is true that in the case of people that have committed crimes in the US and have served jail time,
sentences.zh: 确实，对于那些在美国犯过罪并在监狱服过刑的人来说，

sentences.en: it's pretty common that their countries of origin may say no when America is asking to send them back.
sentences.zh: 当美国要求将他们遣返回国时，他们的原籍国通常会拒绝，这种情况相当普遍。

sentences.en: But I've been looking into these deportations, and I've seen this practice is sweeping up people with all kinds of different backgrounds, not just people with criminal backgrounds.
sentences.zh: 但我一直在调查这些驱逐行动，我发现这种做法正在波及各种不同背景的人，而不仅仅是有犯罪背景的人。

sentences.en: It is true.
sentences.zh: 这确实是真的。

sentences.en: There are a number of people that have committed crimes that are getting deported this way.
sentences.zh: 确实有一些犯过罪的人正以这种方式被驱逐。

sentences.en: But there's also another class of people that's also quite large that are being deported this way
sentences.zh: 但还有另一类人数相当庞大的人群也在以这种方式被驱逐，

sentences.en: who are people that immigration judges had banned from being deported to their countries of origin because if they were, they faced a credible threat, usually of torture.
sentences.zh: 他们是那些移民法官曾禁止将其驱逐回原籍国的人，因为如果回去，他们将面临严重的威胁，通常是酷刑。

sentences.en: And these are the reasons why the Trump administration has had trouble deporting these people.
sentences.zh: 这就是特朗普政府在驱逐这些人时遇到麻烦的原因。

sentences.en: And for the last few months, I've been talking to one man in particular who's been swept up in this, and his name is Roberto Mosquera.
sentences.zh: 在过去的几个月里，我一直在和一个被卷入其中的人交流，他的名字叫罗伯托·莫斯克拉。

sentences.en: So tell us about Roberto.
sentences.zh: 给我们讲讲罗伯托吧。

sentences.en: Who is he?
sentences.zh: 他是谁？

sentences.en: Hey, Roberto.
sentences.zh: 嘿，罗伯托。

sentences.en: How are you doing?
sentences.zh: 最近怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm doing okay, man.
sentences.zh: 我挺好的，老兄。

sentences.en: Okay, good.
sentences.zh: 那就好。

sentences.en: Well, Roberto Mosquera is 59, and he's been in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 罗伯托·莫斯克拉今年59岁了，他几乎一生都在美国度过。

sentences.en: almost all of his life.
sentences.zh: 几乎一生都在美国度过。

sentences.en: I was born in Cuba, but I was raised in America.
sentences.zh: 我出生在古巴，但我在美国长大。

sentences.en: He came in 1980 from Cuba in a boat lift.
sentences.zh: 他在1980年通过船民行动从古巴来到这里。

sentences.en: I came here with my mother and my sister.
sentences.zh: 我是和母亲以及姐姐一起I来的。

sentences.en: We ran away from the communists, you know, in Cuba.
sentences.zh: 我们在古巴逃离了共产主义者，你知道的。

sentences.en: And Roberto was only 12 when he came, so this is the only country he's really known as home.
sentences.zh: 罗伯托来的时候只有12岁，所以这是他真正知道的唯一的家乡。

sentences.en: He remembers a little bit about Cuba, but he doesn't remember that much.
sentences.zh: 他对古巴还保有微弱的记忆，但已经记不太清了。

sentences.en: And they settled into Miami.
sentences.zh: 他们在迈阿密安顿下来。

sentences.en: I didn't have no father.
sentences.zh: 我没有父亲。

sentences.en: And my mother, she tried best, but it was very difficult to us, you know.
sentences.zh: 我母亲尽了她最大的努力，但我们的生活真的很艰难。

sentences.en: And it wasn't long after they moved that Roberto began to get into trouble.
sentences.zh: 搬家后不久，罗伯托就开始惹上麻烦了。

sentences.en: I wish I could have changed things, you know, and do better with my life, you know.
sentences.zh: 我真希望自己能改变过去，你知道的，把生活过得更好一些。

sentences.en: He became a rebellious teenager, and he joined a gang.
sentences.zh: 他变成了一个叛逆的青少年，加入了一个帮派。

sentences.en: But I was just like, get the freedom that I needed on the streets, you know, without the kids, like, hanging around and fighting.
sentences.zh: 我只是想在街头获得我需要的自由，不用跟小孩子们一样闲晃和打架。

sentences.en: There were a lot of car thefts, shootings, you know, attacking rival gang members in the street.
sentences.zh: 当时有很多偷车、枪击事件，你知道的，在街上袭击敌对帮派成员。

sentences.en: And eventually, he ended up going to trial for a shooting that took place.
sentences.zh: 最终，他因一起发生的枪击案而接受审判。

sentences.en: Roberto says he actually wasn't part of the shooting.
sentences.zh: 罗伯托说他其实并没有参与那场枪击。

sentences.en: He admitted to all kinds of crimes, which he committed over the years.
sentences.zh: 他承认了多年来犯下的各种其他罪行。

sentences.en: But he said this was one that he actually hadn't done.
sentences.zh: 但他坚称这件事他真的没有做。

sentences.en: And he took a plea deal.
sentences.zh: 而且他接受了认罪协议。

sentences.en: Even though he said he hadn't committed the crime, he said that his lawyer had said, if you don't take this deal, you're going to be sent to jail for many more years.
sentences.zh: 尽管他说自己没有犯罪，但他说律师曾告诉他，如果不接受这个协议，他会在监狱里多呆很多年。

sentences.en: So he served nine years in jail.
sentences.zh: 于是他在监狱里服刑了九年。

sentences.en: And after being released after those nine years, we're talking about the 1990s now,
sentences.zh: 在服刑九年后获释，我们现在说的是20世纪90年代的事情了，

sentences.en: usually you would be deported at that point.
sentences.zh: 通常在这个时候你会被驱逐出境。

sentences.en: But in Roberto's case, that's not what happened.
sentences.zh: 但在罗伯托的案子里，事情并非如此。

sentences.en: Roberto was from Cuba, and Cuba wasn't cooperating with deportations of people from America at that time.
sentences.zh: 罗伯托来自古巴，而当时古巴并不配合美国将人员遣返回国的行动。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Roberto is one of these people who the United States government may have wanted to deport at one point, but effectively could not.
sentences.zh: 罗伯托就是这样的人：美国政府一度想将他驱逐，但实际上却做不到。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，美国政府当时陷入了一种两难境地。

sentences.en: government was kind of in a bind here.
sentences.zh: 政府陷入了困境。

sentences.en: On one end, they couldn't just send Roberto home, but they also couldn't keep him in jail indefinitely, because to do that to someone, you've got to charge them with something.
sentences.zh: 一方面，他们不能直接把罗伯托送回家，但另一方面，他们也不能无限期地把他关在监狱里，因为要把一个人关起来，你必须对他提出指控。

sentences.en: And they didn't have charges to keep Roberto, like, in jail.
sentences.zh: 而他们当时并没有指控来把罗伯托一直关在监狱里。

sentences.en: So for years, administrations, Republican and Democrat, both determined the only option was to let people out, to let them stay.
sentences.zh: 因此多年来，无论是共和党还是民主党的历届政府都认为，唯一的选择就是把这些人放出来，让他们留下来。

sentences.en: And that's what happened with Roberto.
sentences.zh: 罗伯托就是这样留下的。

sentences.en: So what were the terms under which he was allowed to stay?
sentences.zh: 那么他被允许留下的条件是什么呢？

sentences.en: Like, how did that actually work?
sentences.zh: 这到底是怎么运作的？

sentences.en: The idea was that if Roberto tried to stay out of trouble and made check-ins with immigration authorities, usually every year, he'd be able to get a work permit,
sentences.zh: 当时的想法是，如果罗伯托尽量不惹麻烦，并且定期向移民当局报到（通常是每年一次），他就能获得工作许可，

sentences.en: get a driver's license, basically have a normal life in the United States.
sentences.zh: 拿到驾照，基本上在美国过上正常的生活。

sentences.en: Man, my life, I changed.
sentences.zh: 老兄，我的人生改变了。

sentences.en: I changed my way, man.
sentences.zh: 我改变了我的生活方式，老兄。

sentences.en: I try to do better, you know?
sentences.zh: 我努力把事情做得更好，你知道吗？

sentences.en: And like a lot of people in his situation, he took them up on that offer.
sentences.zh: 就像他这种情况的很多人一样，他接受了这个提议。

sentences.en: I didn't know how to do anything when I got out of prison.
sentences.zh: 我刚出狱的时候什么都不会做。

sentences.en: But then this man, okay, who run this plumbing company, he said, man, listen, I'm going to give you a break.
sentences.zh: 但后来这个人，经营这家水暖公司的老板说，老兄，听着，我给你一个机会。

sentences.en: It's on you if you want to take it.
sentences.zh: 能不能把握住就看你自己的了。

sentences.en: Learn everything you can to hear, and I will help you out.
sentences.zh: 在这里把你能学到的东西都学好，我会帮你的。

sentences.en: And he did.
sentences.zh: 他也确实兑现了诺言。

sentences.en: This was the early 2000s.
sentences.zh: 那是20世纪2000年代初。

sentences.en: He started working as a plumber.
sentences.zh: 他开始当水管工。

sentences.en: I work hard.
sentences.zh: 我工作很努力。

sentences.en: I learn how to do plumbing.
sentences.zh: 我学习水暖技术。

sentences.en: I become a former.
sentences.zh: 我成了工头。

sentences.en: He started at his temp, then he became an apprentice, and then he became a foreman.
sentences.zh: 他从临时工开始，然后成为学徒，最后当上了工头。

sentences.en: And he started a family.
sentences.zh: 并且他组建了自己的家庭。

sentences.en: Man, I worked so hard for my daughters, man.
sentences.zh: 老兄，为了我的女儿们，我工作得太努力了。

sentences.en: He ended up having four daughters here, all American citizens.
sentences.zh: 他最后在这里有了四个女儿，全都是美国公民。

sentences.en: I was trying to be the best father the best way I could, you know?
sentences.zh: 我一直在尽我所能做一个最好的父亲，你知道吗？

sentences.en: So he really established a life here.
sentences.zh: 所以他确实在这里建立了自己的生活。

sentences.en: How long did things continue like that?
sentences.zh: 这种情况持续了多久？

sentences.en: It was for decades.
sentences.zh: 持续了几十年。

sentences.en: He was, in his head, an American.
sentences.zh: 在他的心里，他就是一个美国人。

sentences.en: Even if he didn't have papers saying he was an American, he'd been here since he was 12.
sentences.zh: 即使他没有证明自己是美国人的纸质文件，但他从12岁起就一直在这里了。

sentences.en: But all of that changed last June.
sentences.zh: 但这一切在去年六月发生了改变。

sentences.en: And what happened last June?
sentences.zh: 去年六月发生了什么？

sentences.en: That morning, I got up before I go to work.
sentences.zh: 那天早上，我在上班前起床。

sentences.en: I have Cuban coffee, which I'm missing a lot.
sentences.zh: 我喝了古巴咖啡，我非常想念它。

sentences.en: I go to the gas station, full gas.
sentences.zh: 我去加油站把油加满。

sentences.en: And I went to the ICE, the Tencent Center, like every year.
sentences.zh: 然后我像往年一样去了移民和海关执法局（ICE）的腾讯中心。

sentences.en: Roberto went in for his regular check-in with ICE.
sentences.zh: 罗伯托去ICE进行例行报到。

sentences.en: They took the paper, and then they called me, and they took me inside.
sentences.zh: 他们收下了文件，然后叫了我的名字，把我带了进去。

sentences.en: But this time, it clearly was different.
sentences.zh: 但这一次，情况显然不同了。

sentences.en: And I see this group of immigration officers talking to each other.
sentences.zh: 我看到一群移民官员在互相说话。

sentences.en: They were looking to us.
sentences.zh: 他们在看着我们。

sentences.en: The agent who was there told him,
sentences.zh: 那里的特工对他说，

sentences.en: Your time is up, he says.
sentences.zh: 你的时间到了，他说。

sentences.en: Your time in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 你在美国的

sentences.en: is over.
sentences.zh: 时间结束了。

sentences.en: And that was it.
sentences.zh: 事情就是这样。

sentences.en: He was detained for a number of weeks.
sentences.zh: 他被拘留了好几个星期。

sentences.en: And then he's told he's going to be deported.
sentences.zh: 然后他被告知他将被驱逐出境。

sentences.en: And does he know at this point where he's getting deported to?
sentences.zh: 此时他知道自己要被驱逐到哪里吗？

sentences.en: What are they telling him?
sentences.zh: 他们对他说了什么？

sentences.en: No, no one would tell him anything about where he was going.
sentences.zh: 不，没有人告诉他任何关于他要去哪里的消息。

sentences.en: He thought he was going back to Cuba.
sentences.zh: 他以为自己要回古巴。

sentences.en: He didn't know how that exactly was going to work.
sentences.zh: 他不知道那到底会怎么运作。

sentences.en: And they took him and four other people onto a plane.
sentences.zh: 他们把他和其他四个人带上了一架飞机。

sentences.en: And then when the flight took off, after a few hours, it was clear they weren't going to Cuba because it doesn't take that long to get there.
sentences.zh: 然后当航班起飞几小时后，很明显他们不是去古巴，因为飞到那里不需要那么长时间。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: This is where my mind got stopped running everywhere.
sentences.zh: 这时我的脑子开始疯狂运转停不下来。

sentences.en: You don't know where this plane is going, taking you?
sentences.zh: 你不知道这架飞机到底要把你带到哪里去吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不知道。

sentences.en: I said, what the hell are they doing?
sentences.zh: 我当时说，这到底是怎么回事？

sentences.en: You know, where are we going, you know?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们到底要去哪儿？

sentences.en: And we just stopped flying around, like, hours and hours.
sentences.zh: 而且我们一直在天上飞，飞了好几个小时又好几个小时。

sentences.en: You couldn't see outside.
sentences.zh: 你根本看不见外面。

sentences.en: Every time we're going to land the plane down to fill up with gas, okay, they closed the window.
sentences.zh: 每次我们准备降落加油的时候，好吧，他们就把窗户关上。

sentences.en: They don't want to see where we at.
sentences.zh: 他们不想让我们知道我们在哪儿。

sentences.en: And many hours later.
sentences.zh: 过了很多小时之后。

sentences.en: Seven hours.
sentences.zh: 七个小时。

sentences.en: One of the officers, he came out.
sentences.zh: 其中一个官员走了出来。

sentences.en: And he goes, well, you in Africa.
sentences.zh: 他说，好吧，你们在非洲。

sentences.en: I said, what the hell am I doing in Africa, bro?
sentences.zh: 我说，兄弟，我在非洲到底在干什么？

sentences.en: I don't want to go to Africa.
sentences.zh: 我不想去非洲。

sentences.en: They landed in Africa.
sentences.zh: 他们在非洲降落了。

sentences.en: So he was now getting off of this plane.
sentences.zh: 所以他现在下了飞机。

sentences.en: And at that point, the plane was circled, he said, by military vehicles, local military vehicles.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，他说飞机被军用车辆包围了，当地的军用车辆。

sentences.en: Guns everywhere.
sentences.zh: 到处都是枪。

sentences.en: They surround the whole, like a military.
sentences.zh: 他们把整架飞机包围了，就像军队一样。

sentences.en: These men got out of the plane and were loaded into what looked like a military truck that had what he described as sort of a cage fitted onto it.
sentences.zh: 这些人下了飞机，被装上了一辆看起来像军用卡车的车，据他描述，车上还装有一个类似笼子的东西。

sentences.en: And then I see this big wall.
sentences.zh: 然后我看到了这堵高墙。

sentences.en: And I told this guy, man, I think that looks like a prison, bro.
sentences.zh: 我对这家伙说，伙计，我觉得那看起来像个监狱，兄弟。

sentences.en: And then that truck drove into a maximum security prison.
sentences.zh: 然后那辆卡车开进了一座最高安全级别的监狱。

sentences.en: And that's when this iron door opened and we went inside.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，这扇铁门打开了，我们进去了。

sentences.en: And when he finally found out where he was.
sentences.zh: 当他终于弄清楚自己身在何处时。

sentences.en: Eswatini.
sentences.zh: 斯威士兰。

sentences.en: He was told he was in a country called Eswatini.
sentences.zh: 有人告诉他，他在一个叫做斯威士兰的国家。

sentences.en: A country he had never heard of before.
sentences.zh: 一个他以前从未听说过的国家。

sentences.en: This is a bad dream, you know?
sentences.zh: 这简直是一场噩梦，你知道吗？

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wena Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是刘文娜。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写“拼字迷”（Connections）这款游戏，这是《纽约时报》游戏板块的谜题之一。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢试图捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazurski, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基，我每天创作“拼字蜂”（Spelling Bee）和“字母箱”（Letterboxd）这两款游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“彩色听觉”的现象。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 当我听音乐时我能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由真人制作的，就像你刚才听到声音的这些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com slash games 开始今天的游戏。

sentences.en: Nick, I want to talk about what happened to Roberto once he arrived at this prison.
sentences.zh: 尼克，我想谈谈罗伯托到达这座监狱后发生了什么。

sentences.en: But first, just for people who might be as unfamiliar as he was, tell us a little bit about Eswatini.
sentences.zh: 但首先，对于那些可能和他一样对斯威士兰一无所知的人，给我们简单介绍一下斯威士兰吧。

sentences.en: Yeah, Eswatini is a small country landlocked in South Africa and Mozambique.
sentences.zh: 好的，斯威士兰是一个内陆小国，被南非和莫桑比克包围。

sentences.en: It used to be called Swaziland until its king, who's an absolute ruler, an absolute monarch, changed the name six or seven years ago.
sentences.zh: 它以前被称为斯威士兰，直到其国王——一个独裁者、绝对君主——在六七年前更改了国名。

sentences.en: There's no freedom of speech.
sentences.zh: 这里没有言论自由。

sentences.en: There are no political parties that are allowed.
sentences.zh: 不允许有任何政党存在。

sentences.en: In fact, they're banned.
sentences.zh: 事实上，它们是被禁的。

sentences.en: And this is about kind of the opposite of what you would imagine, a place that you might send someone to from the United States, at least when it comes to human rights.
sentences.zh: 这可以说是你从美国把某人送往的地方的对立面，至少在人权方面是这样。

sentences.en: And just to get back to Roberto's story, what happened when he got to this prison?
sentences.zh: 为了回到罗伯托的故事，他被送到这座监狱后发生了什么？

sentences.en: Well, I mean, they treated him like you would any other prisoner.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我是说，他们像对待其他任何囚犯一样对待他。

sentences.en: I came out in here like a murderer, like a worst of the worSt.
sentences.zh: 我到这里来就像个杀人犯，像最恶劣的罪犯。

sentences.en: They had him stripped down.
sentences.zh: 他们剥光了他的衣服。

sentences.en: They put him in a prison uniform.
sentences.zh: 他们给他换上了囚服。

sentences.en: And they put me against the wall and gave me a prison number.
sentences.zh: 他们让我靠墙站着，并给了我一个囚犯编号。

sentences.en: He spends every day in a small cell with his cellmate from Yemen.
sentences.zh: 他每天都和一个来自也门的狱友待在一个小牢房里。

sentences.en: And he wasn't able to talk to a lawyer.
sentences.zh: 他无法与律师交谈。

sentences.en: But eventually, a friendly prison guard started to let Roberto use his phone every once in a while.
sentences.zh: 但最终，一个友善的狱警开始让罗伯托偶尔使用他的手机。

sentences.en: And Roberto made a call to a human rights lawyer in the United States.
sentences.zh: 罗伯托给美国的一名人权律师打了一个电话。

sentences.en: Now, this isn't a lawyer that's able to get him out because the U.S.
sentences.zh: 现在，这不是一个能把他弄出来的律师，因为美国的

sentences.en: court system, once you're out of American jurisdiction, it can't tell an Eswatini prison to release you.
sentences.zh: 法院系统，一旦你脱离了美国的司法管辖权，就无法命令斯威士兰监狱释放你。

sentences.en: But at least it was a lawyer who could tell him what his right should be.
sentences.zh: 但至少这是一个能告诉他应该拥有什么权利的律师。

sentences.en: And, you know, legally in Eswatini, he has the right to have a local lawyer.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，按照斯威士兰的法律，他有权拥有当地的律师。

sentences.en: But they don't give me no answers.
sentences.zh: 但他们不给我任何答案。

sentences.en: They don't let me see no lawyer.
sentences.zh: 他们不让我见任何律师。

sentences.en: They don't let me, you know, it's just bad, man, you know?
sentences.zh: 他们不让我，你知道的，这太糟糕了，伙计，你知道吗？

sentences.en: But he wasn't able to do that.
sentences.zh: 但他做不到这一点。

sentences.en: Bro, I was so depressed, man.
sentences.zh: 兄弟，我太沮丧了，伙计。

sentences.en: And what Roberto comes to recognize is that he could be stuck here indefinitely.
sentences.zh: 罗伯托渐渐意识到，他可能会无限期地被困在这里。

sentences.en: He's being held without charges.
sentences.zh: 他被关押却没有受到指控。

sentences.en: He's not serving a sentence with a discreet end date.
sentences.zh: 他没有在服刑，也没有确定的刑满释放日期。

sentences.en: He's just here.
sentences.zh: 他就在这里。

sentences.en: And there's no prospect that he can see that this is going to change.
sentences.zh: 而且他看不到这种情况会有任何改变的希望。

sentences.en: It's not easy to pass day by day in this place.
sentences.zh: 在这个地方，一天一天熬过去并不容易。

sentences.en: And would I know if I ever go back?
sentences.zh: 我怎么知道我是否还能回去？

sentences.en: Or if I know if I ever go see my daughters, you know, my people, my family, my life.
sentences.zh: 或者我是否知道我还能不能见到我的女儿们，你知道的，我的人民，我的家庭，我的生活。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So there was a point where he was getting so desperate.
sentences.zh: 所以有那么一刻，他变得绝望至极。

sentences.en: I have to go on a hunger strike.
sentences.zh: 我必须开始绝食抗议。

sentences.en: That Roberto decided that he was going to stop eating.
sentences.zh: 罗伯托决定不再进食。

sentences.en: And that's it.
sentences.zh: 就这样。

sentences.en: One day, the captain came.
sentences.zh: 有一天，队长来了。

sentences.en: I said, listen, man, I'm going on a hunger strike.
sentences.zh: 我说，听着，伙计，我要绝食抗议。

sentences.en: And then I started losing weight.
sentences.zh: 然后我开始消瘦。

sentences.en: I started losing, like, like, like.
sentences.zh: 我开始，就像，像，像是在掉肉。

sentences.en: Just getting weak every single day, you know?
sentences.zh: 每天都在变得虚弱，你知道吗？

sentences.en: I prayed to God, you know?
sentences.zh: 我向上帝祈祷，你知道吗？

sentences.en: And during that time, he was writing.
sentences.zh: 在那期间，他一直在写作。

sentences.en: Do you have the diary that you sent me?
sentences.zh: 你带了你发给我的那本日志吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 带了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: He showed me his diary.
sentences.zh: 他向我展示了他的日记。

sentences.en: And a lot of it is about how much he was missing his life in the United States.
sentences.zh: 其中很大一部分内容是关于他多么怀念在美国的生活。

sentences.en: And how much he was specifically, you know, missing his life that he had with his family before he got deported.
sentences.zh: 特别是，他多么怀念在被驱逐出境之前与家人一起过的生活。

sentences.en: He wrote a lot about his daughter, Faith, who was 10 years old.
sentences.zh: 他写了很多关于他10岁女儿费斯的内容。

sentences.en: Tell me about, tell me about Faith.
sentences.zh: 跟我讲讲，跟我讲讲费斯。

sentences.en: Tell me about your youngest daughter, because you're really close to her.
sentences.zh: 跟我讲讲你的小女儿，因为你跟她特别亲近。

sentences.en: Faith.
sentences.zh: 费斯。

sentences.en: My God, man.
sentences.zh: 我的天哪，伙计。

sentences.en: That's, that's my little one, you know?
sentences.zh: 那是，那是我的小女儿，你知道吗？

sentences.en: That's, that's my last one, you know?
sentences.zh: 那是，那是我的老幺，你知道吗？

sentences.en: And I haven't finished my, my job as a father, you know?
sentences.zh: 我还没有完成我作为父亲的责任，你知道吗？

sentences.en: And that's what hurt me more.
sentences.zh: 这才是最让我心痛的地方。

sentences.en: And Roberto wrote in his diary, every day I think about my daughter, Faith.
sentences.zh: 罗伯托在日记中写道，我每天都在想念我的女儿费斯。

sentences.en: I've never cried so much as I do missing my beautiful girl, my Faith.
sentences.zh: 我从来没有像现在这样因为想念我美丽的女孩、我的费斯而哭得这么厉害。

sentences.en: So sorry, my little girl, how much it hurts me.
sentences.zh: 非常抱歉，我的小女孩，这让我多么心痛。

sentences.en: He wrote,
sentences.zh: 他写道，

sentences.en: I felt like the happiest father in the world seeing you happy.
sentences.zh: 看到你快乐，我觉得自己是世界上最幸福的父亲。

sentences.en: You know, I work very hard for her.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我为她非常努力地工作。

sentences.en: And another point he writes, all for Faith.
sentences.zh: 他在另一处写道，一切为了费斯。

sentences.en: You know?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: As if the whole hunger strike is about getting her back in some way.
sentences.zh: 就好像整场绝食抗议都是为了以某种方式把她找回来。

sentences.en: Yeah, she was everything to me, you know?
sentences.zh: 是的，她对我有如全部，你知道吗？

sentences.en: She was everything to me, man.
sentences.zh: 她对我有如全部，伙计。

sentences.en: And 30 days passed this way.
sentences.zh: 就这样过去了30天。

sentences.en: Oh my God.
sentences.zh: 我的天哪。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It was weak with no eating, and my eyes, I started losing my vision, you know?
sentences.zh: 不吃东西让人虚弱，我的眼睛，我开始视力模糊，你知道吗？

sentences.en: And he had a call with, with his attorney who was in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他和他在美国的律师通了电话。

sentences.en: She told me, Roberto, listen, I need you to get strong.
sentences.zh: 她对我说，罗伯托，听着，我需要你坚强起来。

sentences.en: I need you to get, you know, I need you alive, not death.
sentences.zh: 我需要你，你知道的，我需要你活着，而不是死去。

sentences.en: His lawyer told him, you know, look, you've got to stop.
sentences.zh: 他的律师告诉他，你知道，听着，你必须停下来。

sentences.en: Like, you're not going to get what you need this way.
sentences.zh: 比如，你用这种方法是得不到你想要的结果的。

sentences.en: We've got to find another way to try to fight this.
sentences.zh: 我们必须找到另一种方法来尝试抗争。

sentences.en: The only thing that's going to happen is that you could starve to death.
sentences.zh: 唯一会发生的结果就是你可能会饿死。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And then I said, okay, I'll stop.
sentences.zh: 然后我说，好吧，我停下来。

sentences.en: So Roberto decided to call off his hunger strike.
sentences.zh: 于是罗伯托决定停止绝食抗议。

sentences.en: But it wasn't all for nothing.
sentences.zh: 但这一切并非毫无意义。

sentences.en: After I stopped, he'd come back and give me the phone.
sentences.zh: 我停下来后，他回来了，把手机交给了我。

sentences.en: After the hunger strike, he was allowed to purchase a phone.
sentences.zh: 绝食抗议后，他被允许购买一部手机。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And that phone became his window into the outside world.
sentences.zh: 那部手机成了他通往外部世界的窗口。

sentences.en: That's how I was able to learn about the situation that he and others in Eswatini were in.
sentences.zh: 我就是通过这种方式了解了他以及斯威士兰其他人所处的困境。

sentences.en: It was because of that phone.
sentences.zh: 全靠那部手机。

sentences.en: I mean, once you learned about the situation that Roberto was in, what did you understand about how it all happened?
sentences.zh: 我是说，一旦你了解了罗伯托所处的困境，你对这一切是怎么发生的有什么理解？

sentences.en: Like, how did the Trump administration come to adopt this practice?
sentences.zh: 比如，特朗普政府是如何开始采取这种做法的？

sentences.en: And prior to Trump, were third-country deportations something the U.S.
sentences.zh: 在特朗普之前，第三国驱逐出境是美国

sentences.en: had ever done?
sentences.zh: 曾经做过的事吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, but in a really limited way.
sentences.zh: 是的，但范围非常有限。

sentences.en: There was a practice where if someone's home country wouldn't take them back, you could deport them to what the U.S.
sentences.zh: 过去有一种做法，如果某个人的祖国不肯接收他们，你可以把他们驱逐到美国

sentences.en: had deemed to be a safe third country.
sentences.zh: 认为是安全第三国的地方。

sentences.en: I'm talking about a place like Canada.
sentences.zh: 我说的是像加拿大这样的地方。

sentences.en: This might be a person that, you know, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这个人可能是，你知道的，美国

sentences.en: wanted to deport, couldn't deport back to their own country, but maybe they had some relatives who were in Canada.
sentences.zh: 想要驱逐、但无法驱逐回其本国的人，但也许他们在加拿大有一些亲戚。

sentences.en: And Canada, okay, sending them there.
sentences.zh: 而加拿大同意了，把他们送到那里。

sentences.en: So that was one way to do it.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一种方法。

sentences.en: But this kind of solution doesn't really scale.
sentences.zh: 但这种解决方案其实无法大规模推行。

sentences.en: Most countries are not going to take back hundreds of deportees that have no connection to their country.
sentences.zh: 大多数国家都不会接收数百名与他们的国家没有任何联系的被驱逐者。

sentences.en: But one way you could potentially get a country to agree to something like this is if you offered them money.
sentences.zh: 但让你能潜在地让一个国家同意这种事的其中一个方法，就是向他们提供资金。

sentences.en: And you saw the Trump administration begin to go down that route last spring when it deported about 250 mostly Venezuelan men
sentences.zh: 你看到特朗普政府在去年春天开始走这条路，当时它驱逐了大约250名主要是委内瑞拉籍的男子

sentences.en: to a maximum security prison in El Salvador called SICOT.
sentences.zh: 到萨尔瓦多的一座名为SICOT的最高安全级别监狱。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I remember this.
sentences.zh: 我记得这个。

sentences.en: We covered it on the show.
sentences.zh: 我们在节目里报道过。

sentences.en: The Trump administration accused all of these men of being gang members and criminals, and many of them turned out not to be.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府指控所有这些人为帮派成员和罪犯，结果发现其中许多人并非如此。

sentences.en: And yet they were still stuck in this prison for months.
sentences.zh: 然而他们依然在这个监狱里被困了几个月。

sentences.en: It was a huge story.
sentences.zh: 这是一条重大新闻。

sentences.en: Yeah, this was when a lot of Americans first learned what third-country deportations were.
sentences.zh: 对，这就是很多美国人第一次了解什么是第三国遣返的时候。

sentences.en: It was with Naib Bukele, who is an autocrat, very close to Trump, and also with someone who received $6 million for this deal.
sentences.zh: 当时是在与纳伊布·布克尔打交道，他是一个独裁者，与特朗普关系非常密切，此外还有一个人从这笔交易中获得了600万美元。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: And you saw the government go on now to cut other deals with about 35 countries, including Eswatini, which we know from the record got $5.1 million to take deportees from the U.S.
sentences.zh: 你看到政府随后又与大约35个国家达成了其他交易，其中包括斯威士尼，我们从记录中得知该国获得了510万美元用来接收来自美国的被遣返人员。

sentences.en: Do we have any sense of how many Robertos are out there?
sentences.zh: 我们大概知道外面有多少个罗伯托吗？

sentences.en: Like how many people have been deported to third countries and have been caught up in this kind of limbo where it's not clear when or even if they'll be released?
sentences.zh: 比如有多少人被遣返到第三国，并陷入了这种进退维谷的境地，不清楚何时甚至是否会被释放？

sentences.en: So fortunately, there are people who are tracking this.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，有人在追踪这件事。

sentences.en: There's an organization called Third Country Deportation Watch, and the big number is an estimate of 25,000 people who have been sent through third countries to be deported.
sentences.zh: 有一个叫“第三国遣返观察”的组织，核心数字估计有25,000人被通过第三国发送出去进行遣返。

sentences.en: Now, the 25,000 figure aren't all people in Roberto's situation, and a large number of those people, most of them, were sent to Mexico
sentences.zh: 现在，这25,000人并不都在罗伯托的境地中，其中很大一部分人，也就是大多数人，被送往了墨西哥

sentences.en: largely immediately after they came over and usually not to prisons.
sentences.zh: 基本上在他们过来后不久，而且通常不是被送进监狱。

sentences.en: But there's a subset of the cases, and I'd estimate this is probably about 5,000 people who were being sent to many different places, often maximum security prisons,
sentences.zh: 但其中有一部分案件，我估计大约有5,000人，他们被送往许多不同的地方，通常是最高安全级别的监狱，

sentences.en: sometimes hotels for weeks, sometimes months at a time.
sentences.zh: 有时是一次呆几个星期或几个月的酒店。

sentences.en: These people were sent all over the world.
sentences.zh: 这些人被送往世界各地。

sentences.en: And we talked about there being a precedent for sending people to places like Canada.
sentences.zh: 我们之前讨论过将人送到加拿大之类地方的先例。

sentences.en: Well, now the U.S.
sentences.zh: 好吧，现在美国

sentences.en: is sending people to countries with active conflicts,
sentences.zh: 正在把人送到发生现役冲突的国家，

sentences.en: middle of wars in some cases.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下甚至处于战争中心。

sentences.en: And just recently, the Times reported that detainees who were sent to Equatorial Guinea, which is another country notorious for human rights violations,
sentences.zh: 就在最近，《泰晤士报》报道称，被送往赤道几内亚的被扣押人员——这也是另一个以侵犯人权而闻名的国家——

sentences.en: they were being beaten in a hotel by guards who had custody of them.
sentences.zh: 他们在酒店里遭到看守他们的警卫殴打。

sentences.en: I can imagine a lot of legal objections to what you just described.
sentences.zh: 我可以想象，对于你刚才描述的情况，会有很多法律上的反对意见。

sentences.en: But just to pivot back to the case before the Supreme Court right now, what is the question that the justices will be deciding?
sentences.zh: 但为了转回到目前正摆在最高法院面前的案件，大法官们将要裁决的核心问题是什么？

sentences.en: Well, it's actually a pretty narrow one.
sentences.zh: 嗯，其实这是一个相当狭窄的问题。

sentences.en: So the lower court ruled that these third country deportations are a violation of people's due process rights.
sentences.zh: 因此，下级法院裁定，这些第三国遣返侵犯了人们的正当程序权利。

sentences.en: Essentially, they said these deportees aren't getting an opportunity to appear before a judge to say, hey, don't send me to a third country because, for example,
sentences.zh: 从本质上讲，他们表示这些被遣返人员没有机会出庭面对法官，去说，嘿，不要把我送到第三国，因为比如说，

sentences.en: I might get tortured there.
sentences.zh: 我在那里可能会遭受酷刑。

sentences.en: That lower court's ruling had an immediate consequence for the federal government, which all of a sudden had to stop these deportations.
sentences.zh: 下级法院的这一裁决对联邦政府产生了直接影响，联邦政府突然不得不停止这些遣返行动。

sentences.en: And so the Trump administration appealed to the Supreme Court to ask for an emergency stay.
sentences.zh: 因此，特朗普政府向最高法院提起上诉，请求紧急暂缓执行。

sentences.en: Basically, they want to allow these deportations to continue as this case continues moving through the courts.
sentences.zh: 基本上，他们希望随着案件在各级法院继续审理，允许这些遣返行动继续进行。

sentences.en: Okay, so this is one of those temporary Supreme Court decisions that is less about the merits of the case and more just about, like, does everybody need to stop what they're doing?
sentences.zh: 好的，所以这是最高法院那种临时裁决，它与其说关乎案件本身的是非曲直，不如说更关乎：大家是不是都需要停下正在做的事情？

sentences.en: Until we get a chance to actually consider the merits of the case in months or years or whatever.
sentences.zh: 直到我们几个月或几年后有机会真正审议案件的是非曲直。

sentences.en: But for now, do we know whether or not the court might agree to this to grant this temporary stay?
sentences.zh: 但就目前而言，我们是否知道法院是否会同意批准这项临时暂缓令？

sentences.en: We actually have a fairly good idea just because this question has reached the Supreme Court before.
sentences.zh: 其实我们心里大概有个底，因为这个问题以前就到过最高法院。

sentences.en: Basically, the lower court, you know, paused third country deportations.
sentences.zh: 基本上，下级法院你知道的，暂停了第三国遣返。

sentences.en: And then when that happened, the last time the Trump administration went to the Supreme Court and asked the same question, can we continue to do this anyway?
sentences.zh: 然后当这种情况发生时，上次特朗普政府去最高法院提出同样的问题：我们能不能不管怎样继续这么做？

sentences.en: And the justices said, okay.
sentences.zh: 然后大法官们说，可以。

sentences.en: Did they explain their reasoning, Nick, when they granted the stay before?
sentences.zh: 尼克，他们上次批准暂缓令时，解释他们的推理了吗？

sentences.en: No, not really.
sentences.zh: 没有，差不多没有。

sentences.en: In these cases, when they're acting on an emergency basis, they don't issue a written opinion.
sentences.zh: 在这些案件中，当他们以紧急状态行事时，他们不会发布书面意见。

sentences.en: But what we can say is that the Supreme Court has been very deferential to the Trump administration when it comes to immigration in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 但我们可以说的是，在过去涉及移民问题时，最高法院对特朗普政府一直非常顺从。

sentences.en: They see the president as having very wide latitude here.
sentences.zh: 他们认为总统在这里拥有非常广泛的自由裁量权。

sentences.en: Okay, so it sounds like there's every reason to think that the court would do the same thing this time and let these deportations continue.
sentences.zh: 好吧，听起来有充分的理由认为法院这次也会如法炮制，让这些遣返继续进行。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And by the way, even if the court does decide to pause these deportations, the thing is, it's not quite clear how this would affect Roberto.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，即使法院确实决定暂停这些遣返，问题是，这会如何影响罗伯托并不十分清楚。

sentences.en: Roberto, this case most immediately affects people who are about to be deported.
sentences.zh: 罗伯托，这个案件最直接影响的是那些即将被遣返的人。

sentences.en: And Roberto, of course, has been deported, and he's still in Eswatini.
sentences.zh: 而罗伯托当然已经被遣返了，他现在还在斯威士尼。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: He's already stuck in this legal limbo.
sentences.zh: 他已经陷入了这种法律灰色地带。

sentences.en: What do you think is going to happen to him, Nick?
sentences.zh: 尼克，你觉得他会怎么样？

sentences.en: He asked me the same question the first time that I talked to him on the phone.
sentences.zh: 我第一次在电话里跟他谈时，他也问了我同样的问题。

sentences.en: And I said I didn't know.
sentences.zh: 我说我不知道。

sentences.en: And, I mean, when I was a teenager, it was when America started sending people to Guantanamo Bay.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，当我还是个青少年的时候，正是美国开始把人送往关塔那摩湾的时候。

sentences.en: And it was another situation where, after the war on terror had begun, there was a haste to move people out of the American justice system
sentences.zh: 那也是另一种情况，在反恐战争开始后，人们急于将人移出美国司法系统，

sentences.en: to put them in another corner of the world where there weren't human rights.
sentences.zh: 把他们关到世界上没有人权的另一个角落。

sentences.en: These people, in this case, in Eswatini, aren't terrorist suspects.
sentences.zh: 这些人，就斯威士尼这个案子而言，并不是恐怖嫌疑人。

sentences.en: But they share what's going on with Guantanamo Bay and the fact that they are out of U.S.
sentences.zh: 但他们与关塔那摩湾的共同点在于，他们都脱离了美国的

sentences.en: jurisdiction.
sentences.zh: 司法管辖权。

sentences.en: And so does Roberto.
sentences.zh: 罗伯托也是如此。

sentences.en: We don't know what's going to happen to him.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道他会怎么样。

sentences.en: He could be there for a few more months, but he could be there for a few more years.
sentences.zh: 他可能会在那里再待几个月，但也可能会待上好几年。

sentences.en: And if these cases are completely forgotten about, it could be very much like the situation in Guantanamo where you still have people, prisoners,
sentences.zh: 如果这些案件被彻底遗忘，这可能非常类似于关塔那摩的处境，在那里你仍然有这样的人、囚犯，

sentences.en: who have been there now for many, many years and don't have any way of getting out because no country seems to be interested in taking them.
sentences.zh: 他们在那里已经待了很多很多年，没有任何办法离开，因为似乎没有哪个国家对接收他们感兴趣。

sentences.en: And I think that there is a deep fear that Roberto has that he is just going to get forgotten in this prison.
sentences.zh: 我想罗伯托内心深处有一种深深的恐惧，那就是他会在这个监狱里被彻底遗忘。

sentences.en: Are you hopeful that you're going to get back to the United States?
sentences.zh: 你对回到美国还抱有希望吗？

sentences.en: Do you think that's going to happen?
sentences.zh: 你觉得这会发生吗？

sentences.en: My God, I don't want to lose that hope.
sentences.zh: 天哪，我不想失去这个希望。

sentences.en: Nick, I dream for that, okay?
sentences.zh: 尼克，我做梦都想这样，好吗？

sentences.en: I don't know if it's going to happen.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这会不会发生。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: But I've been fighting for that for a long time, you know, for 13 months, okay?
sentences.zh: 但我为此抗争了很长时间，你知道的，整整13个月，好吗？

sentences.en: But, you know, there's nothing I can do now.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，我现在无能为力。

sentences.en: I'm in God's hands.
sentences.zh: 我听天由命了。

sentences.en: Nick Casey, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 尼克·凯西，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thanks, Rachel.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，雷切尔。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.zh: 英国警方于周日逮捕了五名男子，他们涉嫌准备恐怖主义活动，此前警方接到一个电话称三辆可疑车辆

sentences.en: were headed toward an Air Force base used by the U.S.
sentences.zh: 正驶向美军

sentences.en: military.
sentences.zh: 使用的一个空军基地。

sentences.en: The base, RAF Fairford, is primarily used by the U.S.
sentences.zh: 该基地名为费尔福德英国皇家空军基地，主要供美国空军部署其一些最大的轰炸机，自2月战争爆发以来，美国轰炸机已经从费尔福德起飞执行针对伊朗的任务。

sentences.en: Air Force to deploy some of its largest bombers, and American bombers have launched from Fairford on missions to Iran since the war began in February.
sentences.zh: 目前尚不清楚周日的事件是否与中东冲突有关，但调查人员正在调查是否存在与俄罗斯或伊朗的任何联系。

sentences.en: It is not yet clear whether Sunday's incident is connected to the conflict in the Middle East, but investigators are looking into whether there's any link to Russia or Iran.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由克莱尔·特内斯凯特和莱克西·迪奥制作，罗谢尔·邦霍提供了帮助。

sentences.zh: 我不是指他们睡觉会失去知觉那种。

sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的要求。

sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶的人？
